scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed with substantial friction; 10 exceptional in the observed mobile context. Holistic judgment, not win/loss or completion percentage; limited to assessed content.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent atmospheric shooter with useful mobile assists and legible progress feedback; repeated route execution/collision and offscreen-threat friction dominated these attempts. Second run improved substantially with learning, but paused synthetic play cannot establish continuous enjoyment.
reasons.controls: Large thumb controls, tap-to-aim and two-contact move/fire worked. Scene turning and precise movement around barriers needed frequent inspection/correction; held fire without a clear target wasted ammo. No claim of physical touch feel.
reasons.gameplay: Memory objectives and exposed-coil windows gave understandable progression; preparing for nearby threats improved recovery. Offscreen pressure while navigating and finding a clear coil face felt punishing. Upload and full victory loop unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Strong cyan/amber industrial identity, rain, relay visual and restrained menu/terminal typography; dark tight views and close geometry sometimes dominated screen. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, paused route map, approach assist, clear recovery banners and separate fresh/checkpoint actions helped. Mapping the overhead route to doorways/counters still required repeated corrections. No settings changed.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo/objective and numbered coil status were readable at 390x844. Small tracking-heavy secondary text and dense terminal stats required deliberate paused inspection; threat arrows were hard to convert into useful turns.
